data.name: Lene
data.gender_notes: Lene is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old Norse word ‘leyni’, which means ‘to soothe’ or ‘to alleviate’. Lene is a name that is associated with tenderness, softness, and the ability to offer comfort and tranquility. It is a name that is perfect for a little girl who is expected to grow up to be a compassionate and nurturing individual. The name Lene carries the meaning “Tender, Soft” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Lene usually hope their child will grow to embody tender, soft and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Lene is a name that is deeply rooted in Norse mythology. It is believed that the name is derived from the Old Norse goddess of fertility and abundance, Freyja. Freyja was known for her gentle and compassionate nature, and she was often depicted as a goddess of love, beauty, and motherhood. Lene is a name that carries the spiritual energy of this ancient goddess, and it is a name that is deeply connected to the natural world and the cycles of life.
data.etymology: Lene belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Tender, Soft.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lene total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: לנה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: לנה הוא שם שמשמעותו אלוהים הוא אור ה' לנצח, ומקורו בשורש העברי 'לנ'ה' שפירושו 'להאיר' או 'להאיר באור'. השם לנה מופיע בתנ'ך כחלק מהשמות הנקשרים לאור ולנצח.

in_greek.name: Λήνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Λήνη σημαίνει ἡ λαός ἐλευθερία καὶ ἀνήκει εἰς τὰ ονόματα τῶν Χριστιανικῶν παραδόσεων. Ἡ λέξις Λήνη εἶναι σύντομος μορφή τοῦ ονόματος Ἠλένη, ἡ ὁποία σημαίνει 'torch' ἤ 'φως'.

in_latin.name: Lene
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Lene significat lux Dei, Domini Lux. Etymologia Latina conectit cum vocabulis 'lux' et 'Deus', quae indicant illuminationem divinam. Nomen hoc usitatum est in traditionibus Christianis.
